Investor Peter Schiff tells Tucker Carlson when he first bought gold. He used bar mitzvah money as a boy of thirteen. That was during the great gold run of the 1970s.

Schiff recalls selling near the top in 1980 by luck. Gold had risen from thirty-five dollars to eight hundred fifty. The title claims gold now beats the S and P index. Schiff argues insiders work to keep savers from noticing. The talk is a gold advocate's full case, told through his own long history with the metal. His faith in gold has never wavered since.
